title: OpenDPI Port
description: A data output interface exposed by the data product.

description.description: A human-readable description of what data this port provides.

connections.description: An array of connection-location pairs where this port's data can be accessed.

connection.description: Reference to a connection defined in the connections registry (e.g., #/connections/my_db).

location.description: The specific pointer within the connection. This could be a table name, topic name, file path, or any type-specific location identifier.

schema.description: The shape of the data at this port. Can be an inline JSON Schema or a $ref to a schema in components.

oneOf.description: A reference to a schema defined in components.

$ref.description: JSON Pointer reference to a schema (e.g., #/components/schemas/User).
